title: Python malformed SCHC ingress is delivered to applications instead of dropped
description: Final ACK/rule correctness review: python/src/lichen/node.py:458-479 invokes _on_receive(payload, sender) after SCHC decompression failure, including when the bounded signer tracker is full. This contradicts spec/03-adaptation.md fail-closed drop semantics and exposes malformed compressed bytes as application data. Drop without delivery, routing, or forwarding on every SCHC decode/version failure and on tracker-capacity failure; retain exact-once operator notification for tracked signers. Add callback-negative tests for malformed, truncated, unknown-rule, mismatch, and tracker-full sources.
